name: @mgcrea/mcp-appstore-connect

tools.name: app_store_connect_auth_status
tools.description: Report whether this server has working App Store Connect credentials, whether writes are enabled, which vendor number is set and where it came from, and — when something is missing — exactly what to set. Call this first when a tool you expected is not listed: an absent tool here means missing configuration rather than a bug.

stderr:
[appstore-connect-mcp] @mgcrea/mcp-appstore-connect@0.27.1 (git 7e6afb4 2026-09-26T15:31:37+02:00, node v22.23.3)
[appstore-connect-mcp] appstore-connect-mcp connected (keyId=undefined, vendor=unset, writes=disabled)
[appstore-connect-mcp]   not configured — only app_store_connect_auth_status is available:
[appstore-connect-mcp]   Set APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID (the 10-character key id).
[appstore-connect-mcp]   Set APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID (a UUID).
[appstore-connect-mcp]   No private key found. Set APP_STORE_CONNECT_P8_PATH to your AuthKey_XXXX.p8 file (or APP_STORE_CONNECT_P8 to its inline PEM contents), or add `p8Path` to /tmp/config/appstore-connect/config.json.
[appstore-connect-mcp]   Create the key at https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/access/integrations/api — the .p8 is downloadable exactly once.
[appstore-connect-mcp]   Then restart the server.
